title: Runtime upgrade contract: deprecation windows, gated rollouts, and LTS branching
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: define an explicit, enforceable runtime versioning & upgrade contract that minimizes surprise for customers and platform teams while enabling safe evolution. Scope covers public runtime API surface (HTTP/GRPC endpoints, request/response schema, control-plane flags that affect inference correctness), binary/runtime behavior that affects client compatibility (prefix caching semantics, KV cache interchange format), and rollover of LTS branches. Excludes internal CI tooling and single-node infra config changes unless they alter runtime request/response contracts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A public doc (CONFLUENCE) that states semver rules and deprecation windows for stable and LTS channels. 2) A set of automated pre-merge checks that fail PRs introducing breaking changes unless a deprecation plan is attached. 3) An upgrade-checker CLI (or CI job) that can validate compatibility between two runtime artifacts and emit a graded risk report. 4) Canary rollout policy codified in release automation with thresholds and automatic rollback triggers. 5) Migration guide + example client changes for top-5 breaking-change classes.
decisions: - Adopt semantic versioning MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH for public runtime API. - Any MAJOR increment may include breaking behavioral changes; MINOR may include backward-compatible feature additions and opt-in flags; PATCH is for bug fixes only. - Introduce a short-lived "compatibility-preview" label for changes that are opt-in behind feature flags for one full release cycle. - LTS branches: every 6 months the team may designate a runtime release as LTS with a 12-month bugfix-only window; LTS receives security fixes and critical regressions via PATCH-level updates only. - Deprecations must have a minimum 90-day notice for hosted API users and 180-day for Dedicated/Private customers unless a security issue mandates accelerated timelines.
rollout_plan: 1) Pre-merge: run compatibility tests (unit + integration) against a matrix of pinned client SDK versions. 2) Merge gating: require a signed deprecation plan for any API-change PR. 3) Continuous rollout: staged canary (1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) over 72 hours with performance & error SLO checks at each step. 4) Telemetry gating: rollback if error rate increases > 3x baseline or latency p50/p95 regresses > 30% for > 15 minutes. 5) Post-rollout: 30-day monitoring window and automated regression detection alert to release-engineering and oncall.
migration_steps: - For client teams: identify affected endpoints and map to new request/response fields using the provided compatibility report. - We will ship server-side deprecation headers (Deprecation: true; Sunset-Date: YYYY-MM-DD) for 90/180-day windows. - Provide sample patches for official SDKs (Python, Typescript, Go) and include feature-flag fallbacks when applicable. - Offer a migration assistance runbook for Dedicated/Private customers: on-prem upgrade checklist, DB/migration snapshot guidance, and contact path for Concierge migrations.
